title: WaterlooWorks JSON export (Posting ID always included)
$comment: Current exporter contract including mandatory Posting ID. The payload contains neither schema_version nor exportOptions. x-export-option, x-always-exported and x-change are documentation annotations; x-change refers to the section expansion in commit 157e7f2. Only posting_id is required within each job. This schema cannot enforce total_jobs/jobs length, nonempty job identity or safe database upsert policy.

total_jobs.description: Number of exported job objects, not necessarily the number of unique posting IDs. The extension UI does not download an empty result.

posting_ids.description: Deduplicated nonempty posting IDs in encounter order. Not guaranteed to align by index with jobs. Present even when search-result information is unchecked.

job.description: Posting ID is always included. All other fields can be omitted by deselecting their options. When all content options are deselected, each job contains only posting_id.

posting_id.description: Posting identifier from the search-result row. String, not an integer; may be empty if the source row has no ID. Always exported independently of all checkbox selections.

title.description: Job title from the search-result row.

openings.description: Opening count as display text, not a JSON number.

level.description: Level as display text, not an array.

apps.description: Application count as display text, not a JSON number.

app_deadline.description: Deadline display text from the search-result row; not ISO 8601 and has no guaranteed timezone.

raw_text.description: Search-result cells joined with | and whitespace normalized.

work_term.description: Work term. Whitespace-normalized overview text. Empty string when selected but unavailable.

job_type.description: Job type. Whitespace-normalized overview text. Empty string when selected but unavailable.

job_title.description: Job title from the overview; independent of title.

number_of_job_openings.description: Opening count from the overview as a string, not a number.

job_level.description: Level from the overview as whitespace-normalized text, not an array.

region.description: Region. Whitespace-normalized overview text. Empty string when selected but unavailable.

job_address_line_one.description: Job - Address line one. Whitespace-normalized overview text. Empty string when selected but unavailable.

job_address_line_two.description: Job - Address line two. Whitespace-normalized overview text. Empty string when selected but unavailable.

job_city.description: City from the overview; independent of city.

job_province_state.description: Job - Province/State. Whitespace-normalized overview text. Empty string when selected but unavailable.

job_postal_zip_code.description: Job - Postal/Zip code. Whitespace-normalized overview text. Empty string when selected but unavailable.

job_country.description: Job - Country. Whitespace-normalized overview text. Empty string when selected but unavailable.

employment_location_arrangement.description: Employment location arrangement. Whitespace-normalized overview text. Empty string when selected but unavailable.

work_term_duration.description: Full duration display text. Unlike the previous export, this field can now be deselected and omitted.

special_job_requirements.description: Special job requirements. Whitespace-normalized overview text. Empty string when selected but unavailable.

job_summary.description: Job summary. Whitespace-normalized overview text. Empty string when selected but unavailable.

job_responsibilities.description: Job responsibilities. Whitespace-normalized overview text. Empty string when selected but unavailable.

required_skills.description: Required skills. Whitespace-normalized overview text. Empty string when selected but unavailable.

compensation_and_benefits.description: Free-form full text, not a parsed salary or numeric amount.

targeted_degrees_and_disciplines.description: Plain text including collapsed program lists; not an array. UI button text is excluded; headings such as Targeted Clusters may remain.

application_deadline.description: Deadline display text from the overview; not ISO 8601 and has no guaranteed timezone.

application_documents_required.description: Plain text as displayed, commonly comma-separated; not an array.

additional_application_information.description: Additional application information. Whitespace-normalized overview text. Empty string when selected but unavailable.

application_method.description: Application method. Whitespace-normalized overview text. Empty string when selected but unavailable.

company_organization.description: Organization from the overview; independent of organization.

company_division.description: Division from the overview; independent of division.

service_team.description: Table rows containing ordered string cell values, not objects. Row width and role names are not fixed. Empty when unavailable.

hires_by_faculty.description: Hires by faculty. Source-dependent structured hiring section or null.

hires_by_student_work_term_number.description: Hires by student work-term number. Source-dependent structured hiring section or null.

most_frequently_hired_programs.description: Most frequently hired programs. Source-dependent structured hiring section or null.

hiringHistory.description: Already existed before this change. WTR report objects can contain title, description, columns, rows, series, categories, value and data, with source-dependent inner data. Posting/HTML representations contain tables, lists and text_lines. Keep nested data as JSON; no fixed internal table or chart schema is guaranteed.
